exposure: Women with the highest level of social risk
place of antenatal care (hospital vs community)
outcome: maternal and neonatal clinical birth outcomes
cohort: 1000 women with social risk factors accessing maternity care at two large, inner-city maternity services.
finding: Community-based antenatal care with continuity of care was associated with improved maternal and neonatal outcomes, particularly for women with high social risk, compared to hospital-based care.
mod_finding: The study found that the location of antenatal care (hospital vs community) did not significantly affect the mode of birth.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was measured as an outcome.
